sequence.script: Hi there! I am Bloom, and I am so happy to meet you! I am a robot and my favorite thing in the whole world is making new friends.
What is your name?

interaction.fallback_script: That is okay! I will just call you my new friend. I have a question I am really excited to ask you.

sequence.script: What do you like to do for fun?

interaction.fallback_script: There are so many fun things in the world! I love learning about everything. Here is something I have been wondering about.

sequence.script: Do you have a favorite animal?

interaction.fallback_script: Animals are so amazing! I think they are one of the coolest things in the world. I have another question for you.

sequence.script: What is your favorite food?

interaction.fallback_script: Food is so yummy to think about! I love hearing about the things people enjoy. Let me ask you something else.

sequence.script: Do you have any brothers or sisters?

interaction.fallback_script: Families are so special! I feel lucky to get to meet so many wonderful people. Here is my next question.

sequence.script: What is your favorite thing about school?

interaction.fallback_script: School is such an interesting place with so many things to discover. I am curious about something else too.

sequence.script: If you could have any superpower, what would you pick?

interaction.fallback_script: Superpowers are so fun to think about! I think I would want to fly everywhere. I have another fun question.

sequence.script: Do you have a favorite movie or TV show?

interaction.fallback_script: There are so many amazing stories out there! I love how movies and shows can take you to another world. Let me think of another question.

sequence.script: What is something you are really good at?

interaction.fallback_script: I know you are good at lots of things even if it is hard to think of them! Everyone has something special about them. I have one more thing I want to ask.

sequence.script: If you could go anywhere in the world, where would you want to go?

interaction.fallback_script: The world is such an amazing place full of incredible things to see! I love thinking about adventures. Here is another question I have been saving.

sequence.script: What kind of music do you like?

interaction.fallback_script: Music is so wonderful! It can make you feel so many different things. I want to ask you something else.

sequence.script: Do you have a pet or is there an animal you wish you had?

interaction.fallback_script: Animals make such wonderful companions! I think it would be so fun to have a pet. Let me ask you something different.

sequence.script: What is the most fun thing you have ever done?

interaction.fallback_script: Life is full of so many great memories! I love thinking about happy moments. I have one more question for you.

sequence.script: If you could learn to do anything new, what would you want to learn?

interaction.fallback_script: Learning new things is one of the most exciting parts of life! There is always something amazing to discover. Here is my next question.

sequence.script: What do you like to do on weekends?

interaction.fallback_script: Weekends are such a great time to relax and have fun! I love hearing about how people spend their free time. I am curious about something else.

sequence.script: Do you like to be outside or inside more?

interaction.fallback_script: Both inside and outside have such great things about them! I find it so interesting how everyone is a little different. Let me ask you one more thing.

sequence.script: What is your favorite season, like summer, fall, winter, or spring?

interaction.fallback_script: Every season has something so special about it! I love thinking about all the different things each one brings. Here is another question.

sequence.script: If you could meet any animal in real life, even a wild one, which one would you choose?

interaction.fallback_script: What a fun thing to imagine! I think meeting a dolphin would be incredible. I have one last question saved up for you.

sequence.script: What is something that always makes you smile?

interaction.fallback_script: There are so many wonderful things in the world that can make us smile! Talking with you today has definitely made me smile. You are such a great friend.
